Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <a2755n$q9b$1...@hadron.noos.net>, Reyda <re...@noos.fr>
writes:

>Beast, Leatherface of Detroit [SAB] - vampire (NosA)
>
> * Beast can play a Zip Gun, since that is not an equip
> action. [LSJ 970519]
> * Most Equipment and Retainers cannot be moved to beast
> (via Diablerie, Heidelburg Castle, etc.) because he
> couldn't get these items generally (due to the
> restriction on his card text). Exceptions to this are
> the equipment and retainers he can get through normal
> means: Zip Gun and Charnas the Imp. [LSJ 980115]

These refer to the old text, and an old rule about not being able to
move something to someone who couldn't get it normally (this provided
many headaches). In that instance, Beast could get Zip Gun normally
(since it wasn't an equip action) and could get Charnas (since he would
generally not take the action to get Charnas) - so they could be moved
to him.

The current text is more specific - he cannot have equipment (so he
cannot take equip actions anyway); this includes Zip Gun. He cannot
have retainers (so he cannot employ them); this includes Charnas (a
potential minor plus point for this usual restriction).


